authority.empirical_release_rule: No #85 empirical execution or result inspection is permitted unless #88 independently passes against the exact corrected #81 freeze.

secondary_horizons.reason: A five-session horizon is the single preregistered weekly operational sensitivity and aligns with the frozen five-row retraining cadence without introducing a horizon sweep.
secondary_horizons.target_formula: sum the five consecutive governed next-session selected-contract within-contract log returns beginning after the prediction cutoff
secondary_horizons.roll_rule: All five constituent next-session returns must be valid within-contract returns under the frozen selected-contract semantics; any origin whose five-session path contains a prohibited cross-contract return is ineligible rather than stitched across the roll.
secondary_horizons.overlap_rule: Daily prediction origins are retained, so adjacent five-session targets may overlap; the frozen dependence-aware uncertainty procedure remains required.
secondary_horizons.training_label_availability_rule: At each prediction cutoff, training labels are usable only when their complete five-session endpoint is already observable.
secondary_horizons.purge_rule: Purge the final H-1 = 4 candidate training origins at each OOS boundary when their five-session labels are not fully observable at that cutoff.
secondary_horizons.embargo_rule: No additional post-OOS embargo is introduced; the label-availability and H-1 purge rules are the leakage control.
secondary_horizons.oos_origin_rule: Use the frozen primary OOS origin sequence, retaining only origins for which the complete five-session target is deterministically observable under the same-contract rule; the final incomplete origins and roll-invalid origins are ineligible by construction.
secondary_horizons.coverage_rule: Predictions and required inputs must cover 100% of eligible H5 origins; ineligible origins may not be silently imputed or redefined.
secondary_horizons.model_rule: Reuse the exact frozen #82, #83 and #84 model/component definitions, source-manifest identities, seeds and deterministic 50/50 fusion rule. The horizon change may alter only the supervised target/label construction required to estimate the same candidate definitions; no hyperparameter, feature, seed, checkpoint, fusion-weight or architecture search is permitted.
secondary_horizons.metric_rule: Use the #78 RMSE identity and directionality on the H5 target with a distinct H5 experiment identity. H5 metric values are sensitivity evidence and are not directly substituted for the primary H1 longitudinal metric.
secondary_horizons.uncertainty_rule: Use the #81 moving-block bootstrap and secondary nonoverlapping-block sign-flip MSE procedure with the frozen block size, resample count, confidence and seed; no H5-specific tuning is permitted.

regime_and_period_sensitivity.regime_definition: Reuse exactly #81 pit-trailing-range20-initial-train-tertiles-v1 with thresholds frozen from the initial training window.
regime_and_period_sensitivity.chronological_period_definition: Reuse exactly the #81 three contiguous chronological OOS periods and remainder assignment rule.
regime_and_period_sensitivity.reporting: Report candidate/comparator RMSE deltas for every frozen low/medium/high regime and chronological third for H1 and H5 when eligible. These slices are robustness diagnostics and do not create additional F85 p-values or promotion authority.

inferential_members.p_value: paired H5 fusion-vs-zero loss-difference significance p-value under the frozen #81 uncertainty procedure
paired H5 fusion-vs-Kronos loss-difference significance p-value under the frozen #81 uncertainty procedure
paired H5 fusion-vs-indicators loss-difference significance p-value under the frozen #81 uncertainty procedure

stop_rules: Stop if #88 has not independently passed the exact corrected #81 freeze.
Stop if an H5 target would require a cross-contract return or post-cutoff value.
Stop rather than change the H5 horizon, purge, eligibility, comparator, uncertainty or multiplicity rule after any #85 result is inspected.
Stop rather than add another horizon, regime, calendar slice, model family, feature family, seed, threshold or fusion rule to rescue a null or negative result.
